requirements: active and visible in the pinned SimplifyJobs source
new-grad, graduate, entry-level, junior, associate, Engineer I/1, or university-graduate title signal
software, backend, platform, cloud, infrastructure, data, AI, or ML engineering title signal
exclusions: senior, staff, principal, lead, manager, and level 2+ titles
obvious security-clearance, defense, or military-oriented roles
test, QA, hardware, analyst, consulting, and obvious staffing-feed noise
Simplify, Jobright, and other aggregator URLs

url_verification.method: HTTP GET with redirects enabled; final host checked against aggregator denylist; response body scanned for explicit existing-clearance requirements

defaults.sponsorship: Blank means unknown; only explicit source restrictions are retained.
defaults.work_model: Remote only when the source location explicitly says remote.

caveats: This is a point-in-time snapshot; employer pages and Simplify active flags can change after the audit.
HTTP 200 proves the page responded during refresh, not that an employer will keep accepting applications.
Eligibility is conservatively inferred from source metadata and title/location signals; full job descriptions were not republished.
Eight dream-company stretch rows are clearly marked for manual experience-requirement review and are not asserted to be new-grad roles.
Datadog, Wiz, Temporal, Vercel, and Okta had no active listing in the pinned source snapshot and should be monitored in a future refresh.
No salary, fit score, interview chance, qualifications, or resume-match claims were invented.
